# FocusGrab

> **File:** `services/FocusGrab.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

A focus grab, for surfaces that close (or drop keyboard focus) on a click outside them: while `active`, keyboard focus stays in `windows` and a click anywhere else ends the grab (`cleared`). Hyprland's focus grab (HyprlandGrab) where the compositor has one (CompositorManager.supports. focusGrab); elsewhere the grab ends once keyboard focus has left every one of `windows` (a click on another window or surface takes it), which only works for windows that take keyboard focus. Not a singleton: each surface makes its own.

### Properties

- `windows` (var)
- `active` (bool)

### Signals

- `cleared()`
